issue_request: FHIR-51726 is Applied/Persuasive for R6 and requested moving MedicationRequestAdministrationLocationCodes back to FHIR Core rather than treating it as a THO code system, with canonical/id changed to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medicationrequest-category and http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/medicationrequest-category and terminology naming moved away from the administration-location-only label.
initial_application: PR HL7/fhir#3896 applied the issue in commits 4a73291f0c and c23f0477b6 by adding source/medicationrequest/codesystem-medicationrequest-category.xml, renaming the value set source to source/medicationrequest/valueset-medicationrequest-category.xml, and changing the active MedicationRequest and MedicationStatement category bindings to the core medicationrequest-category ValueSet. Commit 2571d5b4b2 in PR HL7/fhir#3911 completed category naming cleanup for the value set while adding later ballot-note context.
additional_context: FHIR-50142 and FHIR-31632 support the same pharmacy example-terminology move-back-to-core family, and UP-555 was the unresolved UTG proposal cited by the seed as evidence that this should not be handled as a THO change. Later FHIR-53306/PR #3911, Zulip PR review discussion, and Pharmacy minutes added ballot notes saying these category code systems may still move to THO after broader review; FHIR-53306 is not Applied/Published. Later FHIR-55335 and FHIR-55337 remain unresolved THO-candidate migration issues.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit.
